limits: A scripted teaching conversation using the native shared model; each assessment reloads its saved checkpoint with fresh recurrent context.
Explicit corrected answers are learned through supervised online updates and existing stage replay. The learner does not judge its own answers or learn from its generated mistakes.
One pass means one direct source exposure to each short correction. Replay may add exposures; report its counters separately.
Only the first round is a one-exposure diagnostic. Later rounds deliberately repeat corrections; they are not evidence of learning instantly from one conversation.
Weights, optimizer state and replay history resume from the full admitted prose checkpoint. No new model is initialized and no ancestor is overwritten.
Generation process time includes checkpoint loading, GPU setup and prompt processing; it is not isolated decode throughput.
Diagnostic descendants are not admitted as teachers or parents.
